nodes.name: HubSpot Deal Stage Webhook
nodes.notes: Subscribe a HubSpot app webhook to deal.propertyChange (dealstage), or call from a HubSpot workflow. Responds 200 immediately.

nodes.name: Load Config
nodes.notes: Validates env vars and fails fast. SANDBOX_MODE defaults to true.

nodes.name: Loop Over Deals
nodes.notes: Processes one deal per iteration so batched HubSpot deliveries stay isolated.

nodes.name: HubSpot: Fetch Deal
nodes.notes: [sandbox-safe] Read-only. Source of truth: the event payload is never trusted for deal data.

nodes.name: HubSpot: Fetch Company
nodes.notes: [sandbox-safe] Read-only. Missing company is reported by the validation gate.

nodes.name: HubSpot: Batch Read Contacts
nodes.notes: [sandbox-safe] Read-only batch read (POST is HubSpot's read API shape).

nodes.name: Stop: Duplicate or Invalid
nodes.notes: Idempotency or validation stopped this deal. See $json.gate.reason in the execution log.

nodes.name: Live Mode? (SANDBOX_MODE=false)
nodes.notes: [sandbox-gate:live-output=0] Fail-safe: anything other than mode "live" routes to the sandbox dry run.

nodes.name: Slack: Post Sandbox Preview
nodes.notes: [sandbox-safe] Internal dry-run preview to the approval channel only.

nodes.name: Assert Live Mode
nodes.notes: Defense in depth: re-reads SANDBOX_MODE from the environment before any write.

nodes.name: HubSpot: Mark Provisioning
nodes.notes: Writes onboarding_status=provisioning + idempotency key BEFORE creating resources.

nodes.name: Slack: Invite Internal Team
nodes.notes: Internal team members only. External client emails are NEVER invited here.

nodes.name: Workspace: Create Project
nodes.notes: Provider-agnostic (ClickUp / Asana / Notion). URL, method and body come from src/provisioning-planner.js.

nodes.name: LLM: Draft Kickoff Agenda
nodes.notes: Failures fall back to the deterministic agenda. Contact emails are never sent to the LLM.

nodes.name: Slack: Post Approval Gate
nodes.notes: Internal #cs-handoffs only. Human-in-the-loop gate before any external invite.

nodes.name: Verify Gate Posted & Build CRM Update
